steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Plate NIH/3T3 Flp‑In cells (Thermo Fisher, catalog R76107) at 1.62 × 10⁶ cells per 10‑cm dish in 10 ml growth medium and incubate at 37 °C until ~80 % confluency (≈18–24 h).

steps.title: Transfect cells with reporter and Flp
steps.instruction: Perform transfection using the specified DNA and GenJet mixes, then add to cells and replace media after 12–18 h.

substeps.instruction: One hour before transfection, aspirate existing medium and add 6 ml fresh growth medium to each plate.

Prepare DNA mix for each reporter plate: in a 1.5 ml tube combine 1.35 µg pEF5‑FRT‑GFP‑Kif26b (Addgene #102862) and 12.15 µg pOG44 (Thermo Fisher, catalog V600520) with 675 µl serum‑free DMEM (plain DMEM).
Prepare DNA mix for the GFP control plate: combine 13.5 µg pCAG‑GFP (available upon request) with 675 µl serum‑free DMEM (no pOG44).
Note that total DNA per mix is 13.5 µg; use a 1:10 molar ratio of reporter plasmid to Flp‑recombinase (adjust masses if plasmid sizes differ).
Prepare GenJet mix for each plate: in a separate 1.5 ml tube add 40.5 µl GenJet transfection reagent (SignaGen, catalog SL100488) to 675 µl serum‑free DMEM.
Add the GenJet solution to the corresponding DNA tube (GenJet into DNA, not reverse), vortex gently for 4 sec, and incubate 15 min at room temperature (do not exceed 20 min).
Add the transfection mixes drop‑wise to the appropriate plates, rock gently to distribute, and return plates to the incubator.
After 12–18 h, examine the GFP control plate under a fluorescence microscope to assess transfection efficiency, then aspirate the transfection medium and add 10 ml fresh growth medium to each plate.

steps.title: Select hygromycin‑resistant colonies
steps.instruction: Apply hygromycin selection, replace media regularly, and pool surviving colonies.

substeps.instruction: Two days post‑transfection, split each 10‑cm dish into four new 10‑cm dishes using growth medium only (no antibiotics).
After cells have adhered, replace medium with growth medium containing 200 µg/ml hygromycin B (Corning, catalog 30‑240‑CR).
Refresh hygromycin‑containing medium every 3–4 days; continue selection for 7–10 days until colonies appear (typically 6–20 colonies per plate).
Pool cells from one or two selected plates into a single well of a 6‑well plate and maintain in growth medium without hygromycin.
Discard the GFP control plate, which should contain no colonies.

steps.title: Coat plates with poly‑D‑lysine
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of 0.1 mg/ml poly‑D‑lysine solution (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog P6407‑10X5MG) to each well of a 48‑well plate, incubate at room temperature 15 min, discard, wash three times with 400 µl sterile water, and air‑dry completely (lid removed). Coated plates may be stored at room temperature for later use.

steps.title: Seed reporter cells for assay
steps.instruction: Plate reporter cells at 0.09 × 10⁶ cells per well in the poly‑D‑lysine‑coated 48‑well plate using 400 µl growth medium per well; aim for ~90 % confluence and seed each condition in triplicate.

steps.title: Treat cells with Wnt‑C59
steps.instruction: The next day gently replace medium with 400 µl growth medium containing 10 nM Wnt‑C59 (Cellagen Technology, catalog C7641‑2s). Incubate until cells reach 100 % confluence (≈1 day). Ensure the monolayer remains intact; if cells retract, repeat plating.

steps.title: Stimulate cells with Wnt5a or control
steps.instruction: Prepare stimulation media: growth medium with 10 nM Wnt‑C59 plus the desired concentration of recombinant Wnt5a (R&D Systems, catalog 654‑WN‑010) for the +Wnt5a condition, or growth medium with 10 nM Wnt‑C59 plus Wnt control buffer for the –Wnt5a condition. Gently replace the existing medium with 400 µl of the appropriate stimulation media, avoiding disturbance of the monolayer, and incubate at 37 °C for 6 h. If additional drugs are used, pre‑treat cells (typically 1 h) before adding the Wnt5a‑containing media.

steps.title: Harvest cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl trypsin‑EDTA (Corning, catalog 25‑052‑CI) per well and incubate at 37 °C for 3–5 min. Neutralize with 500 µl growth medium, transfer the suspension to 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes, and centrifuge at 12,000 × g, 4 °C for 3 min. Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 100–150 µl flow cytometer buffer (1× PBS with 0.5 % FBS), pipette to homogenize, and pass through a 35 µm cell‑strainer cap into a round‑bottom tube. Analyze 30,000 cells per sample on a BD FACScan (or equivalent) and process data with FlowJo.

steps.title: Prepare media and buffer solutions
steps.instruction: Growth medium: DMEM (Corning, catalog 15‑017‑CV) supplemented with 10 % FBS (Thermo Fisher, catalog 16000069), 1× glutamine (2 mM; Corning, catalog 25‑005‑CI), and 1× penicillin‑streptomycin (1 IU/ml; Corning, catalog 30‑002‑CI). Wnt control buffer: 1× PBS (GE Healthcare, catalog SH30256.01) plus 0.1 % BSA (Fisher, catalog BP1600‑1) and 0.5 % (w/v) CHAPS (Thermo Fisher, catalog 28300). Flow‑cytometry buffer: 1× PBS with 0.5 % FBS.
